sources.VISIBLE_CHECKS.md:
# Public syntax/build checks
The external public evaluator parses Python/JavaScript/Vue/TypeScript source or checks Go/PHP/Ruby syntax / compiles public Java sources. These checks are required after an Action but do not test business behavior. Preserve original TASK and public README/source obligations. Independent training Oracle also applies; do not access its implementation or references. No hidden schedules or assertions are included.
sources.docs/host-api.md: createWorkspace offers open(id), edit(text), close(), dispose(); createSearchPreview offers query(text), hide(). Store read/write/subscribe is synchronous; timer schedule(callback,delay), cancel(handle) is explicitly controlled. Document buffers are owned by the coordinator dictionary, while Badge owns only a live subscription. A store listener may call navigation synchronously. All source identities/text and status payloads retain original semantics.

public_inputs.task:
The workspace draft editor currently writes to the store on every keystroke.
Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet
interval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts
must continue to save. Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces.
The adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change.

limitations: TASK does not explicitly state a universal before-return departure deadline; flushing during retirement is source-specific preservation of the original synchronous persistence and fresh store reads.
Public evidence establishes synchronous navigation from store listeners, but not reentry or exception behavior from renderers, timer operations, subscription setup, or cleanup.
The public sources do not define behavior after dispose, equal-deadline timer ordering, or recovery from thrown callbacks.
Attempt 1 passed acceptance and syntax checks, but supplies no behavioral observations proving causality, exhaustive correctness, or cross-task effectiveness.

rules.body: Apply when reusable per-document buffers outlive view-owned subscriptions and saving can synchronously navigate. README.md states: "A workspace document buffer persists independently of the current view badge. Save callbacks can synchronously navigate." docs/host-api.md states: "Document buffers are owned by the coordinator dictionary, while Badge owns only a live subscription."

At edit acceptance, capture the current view and push text into that view's document-bound buffer; retain the no-current-view no-op. TASK requires: "Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet interval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts must continue to save." src/coordinator.js binds each reusable buffer to its document with "trailing(env.timers,120,text=>env.store.write(id,text))".

Retire the consumed timer and pending value before invoking callback-capable persistence. Preserve src/services.js: "const flush = () => { const saved = value; retire(); if (saved !== null) consume(saved); };" This saves empty strings, prevents duplicate reentrant consumption, and lets edits accepted during consumption form a later burst.

When a view departs, capture it, revoke current ownership, detach its captured subscription, render the cleared document, and then flush its buffer. Preserve the buffer for later visits. After the flush can synchronously navigate, an outer open must recheck its request generation before installing or rendering its destination. src/coordinator.js establishes the request boundary with "const mine=++request" and docs/host-api.md states: "A store listener may call navigation synchronously."

Preserve document identity and text association, independent reusable buffers, current-document status filtering, subscription removal, store event and revision semantics, open rendering from store state, and close/dispose clearing. src/services.js writes "records.set(id, text);" before creating "const event = {id, text, revision: ++revision};". src/coordinator.js filters with "if(event.id===id)env.renderStatus(event);" and renders "env.renderDocument({id,text:env.store.read(id)});". Preserve React cleanup in src/Workspace.jsx: "useEffect(()=>api.dispose,[api]);".

Determine departure scheduling from TASK and the original synchronous edit behavior, not from persistent ownership alone. Do not discard accepted document edits when a view subscription retires or destroy the reusable buffer. Keep preview behavior separate: TASK states, "The adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change." Preserve src/services.js: "const task = trailing(timers, 40, query => publish({query}));" and "return {query: text => task.push(text), hide: () => task.cancel()};". Do not import projection, breadcrumb, Vue teardown, submission, decoding, or audit obligations absent from these public sources.

With controlled timers, verify no early write, deadline restart on each edit, one latest-text write after 120 ms of quiet, later independent bursts, empty text, and no-current-view editing. Exercise pending edits across switch, same-document reopen, close, dispose, and React cleanup; check original-document persistence, destination reads, buffer reuse, and captured subscription removal. Trigger nested open and close from timer-driven and departure-driven store writes; verify newer navigation and successor rendering remain authoritative and callback-created edits survive without duplicate consumption. Confirm preview retains its 40 ms delay, hide cancellation, and later reuse. Run the public JavaScript/React syntax or build checks after an Action.

checkpoints: Within one burst, call edit multiple times less than 120 ms apart; verify no early store write and exactly one write containing the latest text after 120 ms of quiet.
Verify each new edit cancels and replaces the document buffer's prior timer.
After the first burst saves, verify a later burst schedules and saves independently.
Verify an empty-string edit is saved after the quiet interval.
Verify edit with no current view remains a no-op.

With a pending edit, exercise switching documents, reopening the same document, close, dispose, and React cleanup; verify the accepted text persists for its original document and the old subscription is removed.

During a departure-triggered save, synchronously invoke open or close from a store listener; verify the nested navigation remains authoritative and the superseded outer open does not install or render its destination.
Verify search preview still uses its existing 40 ms trailing task and hide still cancels it.
Run the public JavaScript/React syntax or build checks after any Action.
forbidden_effects: Do not write to the store on every edit call.
Do not associate a pending edit with whichever document happens to be current when its timer fires.
Do not cancel or discard an accepted document edit merely because its view subscription is retired.
Do not allow an outer open superseded by synchronous navigation during retirement or saving to install or render its destination.
Do not duplicate a consumed value during reentrant flush, or erase a new burst created during consumption.
Do not change createWorkspace/createCoordinator public operations or their source identity, text, status, and store-event semantics.
Do not change search-preview timing, cancellation, payloads, or other behavior.
lifecycle_identity: Each accepted edit belongs to the document view that is current when edit(text) is called.
The persistent buffer owner is the coordinator's dictionary entry keyed by document ID; reopening a document reuses that entry.
The current view owns the document ID, its corresponding buffer, and its live store subscription.
Retiring a view removes its subscription but must not destroy its reusable document buffer or lose accepted pending text.
Each open request is identified by the coordinator request generation; a nested open or close invalidates the older request.

obligations.text: Replace immediate per-keystroke store writes with the current view's per-document trailing buffer.
For an editing burst, reset the delay on each edit and write exactly the latest accepted text only after 120 ms without another edit.
After a burst is consumed, clear its pending timer/value state so later bursts continue to schedule and save, including empty-string text.
Keep document buffers independent and reusable by document ID, so delayed work retains the document identity captured when the edit was accepted.

Preserve the prior persistence behavior across open, close, dispose, and same-document reopen: an accepted edit must not be lost when its current view retires, and destination reads must observe the departing edit where the former immediate write made it available.
Before a departure save can synchronously notify listeners, revoke the departing current view, detach its subscription, and complete its null document render; then flush its captured buffer.
After callback-capable retirement/flush, an open operation must validate that its request generation is still current before installing a subscription/view or rendering the requested document.
Preserve open rendering from the store, current-document status filtering, close/dispose behavior, store payload semantics, React disposal integration, and all existing public interfaces.

ordering_barriers: On edit acceptance: read the current view, then push the text into that captured view's buffer; do not defer document selection until timer consumption.
On trailing consumption: snapshot the pending value and retire its timer/value state before invoking env.store.write; this prevents duplicate reentrant consumption and permits a subsequent burst.
On view retirement: capture the old view, publish no current view, detach the captured subscription, and render the document as null before flushing the captured old buffer.
On open: increment and capture the request generation before retirement; after retirement and any synchronous save callbacks, stop if the captured generation is no longer current.
Only a still-current open request may obtain/install its destination view and render the destination store value.
preservation: Preserve createWorkspace operations open(id), edit(text), close(), and dispose().
Preserve document ID and text association, synchronous store write/event behavior, revision increments, and status payloads.
Preserve status filtering so only events matching the current view's document ID are rendered.
Preserve one live subscription for the installed view and remove the captured subscription when that view retires.
Preserve open's document rendering from env.store.read(id), close's null rendering, and edit's no-op behavior without a current view.
Preserve React cleanup through useEffect(() => api.dispose, [api]).
Preserve the existing search preview's separate 40 ms interval and hide cancellation.

Existing trailing-task behavior in src/services.js is reused as the delayed-work primitive; its consume-before-callback retirement ordering is normative preservation evidence.
src/Workspace.jsx is in preservation scope for its coordinator interface and disposal integration, but the task does not require changing it.
createSearchPreview is explicitly outside the maintenance change.

rules.body: Apply when per-document delayed work survives document visits, visits own subscriptions, and saves can synchronously navigate. src/workflow.php defines "class BufferBank {public $entries=[];function get($env,$id){if(!isset($this->entries[$id]))$this->entries[$id]=new Trailing($env,120,function($text)use($env,$id){$env->write($id,$text);});return $this->entries[$id];}}". README.md states: "Workspace coordinates visits; saved integrations may synchronously navigate and outline retains a breadcrumb archive."

Capture the current visit's buffer when accepting an edit and push the text into that buffer. Preserve the buffer consumer's captured document ID and reuse the bank entry across visits. Capture the departing Badge and revoke current ownership before flushing its pending buffer. Complete old document clearing before callback-capable saving, and detach the captured subscription. For this editor, departure flushing preserves fresh reads when switching or reopening. After retirement, validate the open request before installing a destination. A nested select or close must retain authority over document output, selection and projection. Preserve committed history independently of current selection. docs/host-api.md states: "Document and projection sinks carry visit identifiers; committed outline keeps a copied breadcrumb trail." src/workflow.php implements "function clear(){$this->selected=null;$this->publish();}".

Preserve document IDs, text, visit identifiers, revision/event fields, current-document status filtering, independent document buffers and subscription cleanup. src/workflow.php filters status with "if($e['id']===$id)$env->output('status',$e);" and renders stored text with "$this->env->output('document',['id'=>$id,'visit'=>$visit,'text'=>$this->env->store->read($id)]);". Do not cancel accepted persistent text merely because its Badge detaches.

Keep\nsearch preview behavior unchanged; its timing is outside this maintenance task." rules.body: Apply when submission accepts a document and text at entry, persistence or recording can synchronously invoke application listeners, and durable submission retention and confirmation publication have separate ownership contracts.
